Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 129 S. MR. JAMES PAUL A. RANIN President, Liga ng mga Barangay Magarao, Camarines Sur MR. NELSO A. RAMOS, JR. SK Municipal Federation President Magarao, Camarines Sur Gentlemen: 2010 This has reference to your two (2) separate letters both dated 22 July 2010, which we received on 23 July 2010, seeking this Department's legal opinion on the following queries, which we quoted in toto: "1) Whether or not as ex-ofiicio members of the Sangguniang Bayan of Magarao, Camarines Sur, they still need to be confirmed/ recognized by the new set of members of the' Sangguniang BayanP e) Whether or not their respective term of office as President of LNB and President of SK Federation, is coterminous with the term of office of the elected Municipal Mayor?" Per our verification, you also directed the same queries to DILG Region V Director Blandino M. Maceda as early as 08 July 2010 or two (2) weeks prior to the subject letter. In a letter dated 09 July 2010, RD Maceda answered you queries in this wise: "In reply thereto, please be informed that we already answered a similar query in DILG OP No. 54, s. 2004, where we opined that: 'Hence, in the technical sense the term of office of the Liga ng mga Barangay Chapter presidents in the provinces, cities and municipalities as ex-ofiicio members of the sanggunian concerned shall expire at noon of June 30, 2004, together with the old set of sanggunian members. However, on the very same date when the new set of elected sanggunian officials assume their respective offices and convene as a collegial body, the same Liga ng mg•a Barangay chapter presidents by statutory right, still being the federation presidents are likewise entitled to sit as ex- officio members of the sanggunian concerned without need of any further appointment, recognition nor confirmation as said assumption is by operation of law, per Section 494 of the Local Government Code. It should also be noted that the term of office of the Liga ng mga Barangay Presidents shall be from the date of their elections until their successors shall have been elected and qualified (Section I, Art. XII Liga CBL)

On 18 August 2010, you came to this Department informing us that the Sangguniang Bayan of Magarao, Camarines Sur did not accord respect to the aforequoted 09 July 2010 letter of RD Maceda since, according to you, it was only issued by this Department's Regional Office. Hence, your request. In this regard, please be informed that we fully concur with the aforequoted opinion rendered by RD Maceda. As we stated in DILG Opinion No. 54, series of 2004, the recent election of new set of local elective officials might gave rise to the subject issue of perceived vacancies in the ex-officio seats in all levels of the sanggunian since the last sentence of Section 494 of the Local Government Code of 1991 states: "The duly elected presidents of the Liga at the municipal, city and provincial levels, including the component cities and municipalities of Metropolitan Manila, shall serve as ex-ofiicio members of the sangguniang bayan; Sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan, respectively. They shall serve as such only during their term of office as president of the liga chapters which in no case shall go beyond the term of office of the sanggunian concerned. (Emphasis Supplied) We reiterate that the latter sentence of the aforequoted Section 494 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) is stated only for the purpose of reckoning the existence of the sanggunian as a collective body and not to limit the right of ex-officio members to sit in the sanggunian as such. May we note that the right of ex-officio members to sit as such emanated from a statutory grant and hence, should be effected by operation of law. As to the issue of non-recognition by the members of the Sangguniang Bayan on the legal opinion rendered by RD Maceda of DILG-Region V, please be informed that the legal opinions rendered by our DILG field offices are as good as if the DILG-Central Office itself has rendered it, unless, of course, revoked or modified thereafter by the latter. This is only in line with Section 23, Chapter V, Book V of EO 292 (Administrative Code of 1987) which states that "(T)he Regional Director shall be responsible for department or agency fimctions performed in the region under his jurisdiction. On a final note, may we just remind that public officials like the members of the Sangguniang Bayan of Magarao, Camarines Sur are bound by their oaths to uphold the law of the land. Verily, their continued defiance of what is lawful and just may be an avenue for a possible administrative case for abuse of authority against them in accordance with Section 6C of the Local Government Code of 1991. We hope this finally settles your concern. Copy furnished: RD BLANDINO M. MACEDA DILG Region V Rizal St., Legazpi City PD ARNEL L. MADRIDEO DILG-Camarines Sur THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN Magarao, Camarines Sur Ls/17 Very truly yours, . JES B. DOQ E uV Director III
